extracted_content.title: Overview
extracted_content.content: Modifier EY identifies an item or service that was not ordered by a physician or other licensed healthcare practitioner. This policy outlines Humana's reimbursement for a charge reported with modifier EY.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. The following policy applies to professional services and durable medical equipment, prosthetics, orthotics and supplies (DMEPOS). Humana plans only allow items and services that have been ordered by a physician or other licensed healthcare practitioner. Therefore, Humana plans do not reimburse for a charge reported with modifier EY.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. The following policy applies to professional services and durable medical equipment, prosthetics, orthotics and supplies (DMEPOS). Humana plans only allow items and services that have been ordered by a physician or other licensed healthcare practitioner. Therefore, Humana plans do not reimburse for a charge reported with modifier EY.

Durable medical equipment, prosthetics, orthotics and supplies (DMEPOS): All services included in Original Medicare's DMEPOS Fee Schedule; all services included in Original Medicare's Parenteral and Enteral Nutrition Items and Services (PEN) Fee Schedule; and all services that, though not included in those fee schedules, are of a kind that is typically included in those fee schedules.

Modifier EY: No physician or other licensed healthcare provider order for this item or service.
